alerts.recommendation: Check the same requested object using the declared object-permission policy before exposing it.

alerts.title: HTTP framing length uses permissive integer parsing
alerts.description: A resolved HTTP parser converts a Content-Length or chunk-size value without an observed lexical rejection guard. Python integer conversion accepts extra forms. This is bounded static evidence, not verified deployment exploitability.
alerts.recommendation: Validate the exact decimal or hexadecimal HTTP length grammar before integer conversion; reject signs, prefixes and whitespace.

obligation.required: Validate the exact decimal or hexadecimal HTTP length grammar before integer conversion; reject signs, prefixes and whitespace.
obligation.observed: A resolved HTTP parser converts a Content-Length or chunk-size value without an observed lexical rejection guard. Python integer conversion accepts extra forms.
assumptions: Only visible dominating guards and resolved HTTP library contracts are modelled; caller filtering remains unverified.
Recognizing a lexical guard does not certify its regular expression or all parser paths.

alerts.title: Unsupported transfer codings have no rejecting branch
alerts.description: The HTTP parser handles only the chunked value in its Transfer-Encoding branch and has no alternate rejection in that branch. This is bounded static evidence, not verified deployment exploitability.
alerts.recommendation: Reject unsupported Transfer-Encoding values before choosing a request body reader.

obligation.required: Reject unsupported Transfer-Encoding values before choosing a request body reader.
obligation.observed: The HTTP parser handles only the chunked value in its Transfer-Encoding branch and has no alternate rejection in that branch.
assumptions: This is a narrow branch-shape check, not a complete HTTP framing, proxy or deployment model.
